definitions.full: H1243. baqqarah [ בַּקָּרָה ] verbal noun feminine a seeking , עֶדְרוֺ רֹעֶה כְּבַקָּרַת Ezek 34:12 like a shepherd's seeking his flock .

occurrences.englishText: As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
